column1: # Game profile of Fire Emblem: Three Houses (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.2.0 = v327680). In bring-up

# Koei Tecmo's older KTGL engine on NVN (co-developed with Intelligent Systems), SDK 6.5.0 (the oldest so far); modules main + subsdk0 (GLSLC, NVN's runtime shader compiler) + subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_movie) + sdk.

# RomFS: the LINKDATA archive DATA0.bin (index of 32-byte entries) + DATA1.bin (6.9 GB), loose overrides in patch1–4/ (listed by patchN/INFO0.bin), WebM movies in nx/movie, KTSL sound banks (*.ktsl2stbin).

# Compressed entries and *.gz files are Koei Tecmo's chunked zlib. The shaders are GLSLC outputs in SPKG packages (G2S containers, as in Age of Calamity), loose and inside DATA1.bin (shader_split.py kt_shaders)
# camera on the right stick in the monastery and in battle
# SDK 6: as in Super Mario 3D World (SDK 10) and Link's Awakening (SDK 8), the shared-font address goes as is to ScalableFontEngine::LoadFont, so it must point at the TTF itself (until measured)
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): the game uses SetHeapSize. Link's Awakening's partition until measured
# SDK 6 is NVN API 53: report Super Mario 3D World's 53.313 until the game's own check is measured
# ---- NVN driver constant segments (dmsh_build.py at packaging, nvn_mtl.m filled at run time) ----
# Mario's values until measured over all shaders
# KTGL compiles 9 built-in GLSL shaders at boot with the game's own GLSLC (subsdk0; sources in main). Capture them once on the Mac with DM_GLSLC_CAPTURE=<version dir>/glslc_capture (hle_glslc.c)
